patches.notes:
What's new:
• Controller support: play the whole game with an Xbox, PlayStation or Nintendo controller. A highlight moves between buttons and cards, and button marks match your controller
• Controller layout: A select, B back / No Guard, X hold to inspect, Y options, LB/RB jump between hand and sides or tabs, hold Menu to end your turn
• On-screen keyboard for naming decks and writing with a controller on PC
• New setting: Settings > Gameplay > Controller button prompts
• Sealed and Draft: you open a Leader Pack first (4 Leaders), and the other packs no longer contain Leaders
• Draft is now 6 packs (48 picks)
• Sealed and Draft: choose Standard or Epic packs for the whole run (hosts choose for online events)
• Sealed & Draft now share one main menu tile with a choice of the two; Tutorial sits under Play vs AI
...and more.

news.text:
- Online Sealed: the build timer is shown while you open packs and build; a deck not finished in time forfeits and the opponent wins that round
- Online Draft and Sealed: every player is put into their round match at the same time (some were left waiting in the lobby)
- Online games stay quick late in the game (updates sent to players are much smaller)
- "There is no valid target" notice: an effect with nothing to target is skipped and the game carries on
- Buy packs 1, 5 or 10 at a time and open them one by one
- New achievement for completing the tutorial (150 coins)
- Draft: your drafted cards scroll and show a preview on hover
- Sealed deck builder: bigger, brighter page arrows
- AI players in events have their own avatars
- Hex spells from the AI no longer land on its own cards; online target choices fixed for cards that left the field
- Main menu mode cards: tidier sizes and hover
- Removed cards: Acolyte of Ewyn and Curious Bogal

- Sealed/Draft: after building you return to the lobby, pick the Leader for your next game and press Ready (before every round)
- Deck Editor: choose a sleeve (card back) for each deck; Default uses your Customize choice
- My Decks: right-click a deck to open, rename, move, copy its deck code or delete it
- Deck Editor, Sealed and Draft builders now match: big page arrows and card previews on deck-list rows; Randomize builds from your pool in Sealed/Draft
- Draft lists look like the Deck Editor's and show the card when you hover a row
- Player names are shown beside each Leader in matches
- Holding a card to inspect it in the Deck Editor takes 1.5 seconds
- Achievement and challenge notices wait until you're back at the menu or lobby
- The Emote button sits higher, clear of your Leader
- An attack now follows its target if an effect moves the field around (Eraser Gun hit nothing)
- Grave of Archenvale only counts Spirits; Totem of Life no longer triggers off Constructs (itself)
- Loony Llama no longer reacts to its own summon
- The opponent's graveyard choice (Curious Brushka) no longer opens on your screen
- Online: a card returned to hand (Gust of Wind) flies there instead of breaking and being drawn
- Buttons on a card (Re-equip) go away when you click elsewhere

- New battle music in every match
- News is now your inbox: patch notes for every update, unread markers, and gifts you can claim
- Loony Llama works as written: your play sets its ATK to 1, an opponent's play doubles it, and both changes last
- A once-per-turn ability that's already been used simply doesn't trigger again that turn
- Gust of Wind can target equipped Equipment (it goes back to its owner's hand)
- Vex lets you choose a non-Spirit, and that card is discarded (not erased)
- Devil on your Shoulder: the Spirit you take slides across the table instead of breaking apart

- Controller support: play the whole game with an Xbox, PlayStation or Nintendo controller. A highlight moves between buttons and cards, and button marks match your controller
- Controller layout: A select, B back / No Guard, X hold to inspect, Y options, LB/RB jump between hand and sides or tabs, hold Menu to end your turn
- On-screen keyboard for naming decks and writing with a controller on PC
- New setting: Settings > Gameplay > Controller button prompts
- Sealed and Draft: you open a Leader Pack first (4 Leaders), and the other packs no longer contain Leaders
- Draft is now 6 packs (48 picks)
- Sealed and Draft: choose Standard or Epic packs for the whole run (hosts choose for online events)
- Sealed & Draft now share one main menu tile with a choice of the two; Tutorial sits under Play vs AI
- The Drafted list is wider, in the Deck Manager's look
- Deck Manager pages show four full rows of cards
- No Guard moved to the right side, where End Turn sits
- A card held up with its buttons stays in front of the rest of your hand
- Targeting highlights are tighter and a little softer
- Card inspector shows cards sharper
- Fixed: Feedback could not be sent
- Card update: Sea-Man, Ruler of the Depths
